effects.title: Glass Fracture
effects.desc: Pointed glass shards fan out from the impact, or smoothly close into your layer.

effects.title: Glass Drift
effects.desc: Broad glass slivers float gently into place with a quiet sweep of light.

effects.title: Impact Shatter
effects.desc: A travelling impact scatters beveled shards, or brings them smoothly together in one continuous movement.

effects.title: Classic Burst
effects.desc: Assemble or scatter your text, image or shape into rotating fragments.

effects.title: Glass Spiral
effects.desc: Thin radial shards curve around the impact before assembling into the layer.

effects.title: Heavy Glass
effects.desc: Large glass shards turn and settle with a weighty downward pull.

effects.title: Glass Fall
effects.desc: Pointed shards rise gently into the layer or cascade down as it leaves.

effects.title: Glass Orbit
effects.desc: Flat glass slivers follow a broad curved approach while keeping their faces toward the viewer.

effects.title: Impact Drift
effects.desc: Softly lit, irregular pieces drift together into a calm, solid reveal.

effects.title: Impact Vortex
effects.desc: Beveled fragments sweep around a central vortex and settle into place.

effects.title: Impact Fall
effects.desc: Heavy chunks rise into the layer for a reveal, or tumble down for a hide.

effects.title: Heavy Impact
effects.desc: Thick, irregular chunks turn slowly and pull together with a sense of weight.

effects.title: Impact Orbit
effects.desc: Broad beveled pieces follow a curved approach with restrained rotation.

effects.title: Heavy Shards
effects.desc: Large, thick fragments with a weighty fall and strong shading.

effects.title: Soft Drift
effects.desc: Small fragments gently drift into place with very little rotation.

effects.title: Spiral Burst
effects.desc: Fragments follow curved spiral paths as your layer assembles or breaks apart.

effects.title: Falling Pieces
effects.desc: Fragments fall away, or rise back into place for an entrance.

effects.title: Classic Orbit
effects.desc: Triangular pieces arc into place while their front faces remain visible.

effects.title: Soft Surface
effects.desc: Unfold a soft text surface with optional mouse pressure.

effects.title: Soft Landing
effects.desc: Bring letters into place with staggered spring landings.

effects.title: Shape Shift
effects.desc: Expand text smoothly and morph its contours when the text changes.

effects.title: Liquid Morph
effects.desc: Melt between crisp text shapes.

effects.title: Silk Wave
effects.desc: Settle a smooth fabric wave into a clear headline.

effects.title: Rubber Twist
effects.desc: Ease a gentle twist into place, with optional mouse reaction.

effects.title: Magnetic Assembly
effects.desc: Gather letters toward their anchors and repel them with the mouse.

effects.title: Playful Scatter
effects.desc: Bring letters into place with playful rotation and stagger.

effects.title: Contour Flow
effects.desc: Reveal text with a flowing edge and morph between headlines.

effects.title: Morph Twist
effects.desc: Unfold a bent headline and twist its contours during text changes.

effects.title: Liquid Push
effects.desc: Push text through a flowing horizontal transition.

effects.title: Liquid Lift
effects.desc: Lift text through a flowing vertical transition.

effects.title: Elastic Melt
effects.desc: Stretch text into elastic liquid contours.

effects.title: Ink Spread
effects.desc: Reveal letters with a flowing ink edge.

effects.title: Glass Wave
effects.desc: Bend text through a moving glass lens.

effects.title: Contour Echo
effects.desc: Unfold text into trailing letter outlines.

effects.title: Midnight Lamp
effects.desc: A moving pool of light reveals objects in darkness and casts depth shadows.

effects.title: Terrain Plus Scan
effects.desc: Bright plus markers trace the terrain in depth, with a fading scan trail.

effects.title: Paper Emboss
effects.desc: Your text or transparent logo rises out of a softly lit paper surface.

effects.title: Depth Sweep
effects.desc: A luminous band travels from the foreground into the distance.

effects.title: Grazing Light
effects.desc: A low lamp grazes the foreground and sends shadows across the terrain.

effects.title: Cross Survey
effects.desc: Mixed crosses and plus signs light up the photographed surfaces.

effects.title: Sculpted Light
effects.desc: A soft moving light reveals the depth of your photograph.

effects.title: Golden Hour
effects.desc: Warm light grazes the landscape and deepens its shadows.

effects.title: Moonlight
effects.desc: Cool directional light sweeps across the architecture.

effects.title: Neon Sweep
effects.desc: A violet light moves across a rain-soaked city passage.

effects.title: Letterpress
effects.desc: Recessed contours catch light like a letterpress impression.

effects.title: Blind Emboss
effects.desc: A subtle raised impression on a clean, pale surface.

effects.title: Slate Relief
effects.desc: A recessed mark emerges from dark slate under a moving light.

effects.title: Point Scan
effects.desc: Fine luminous dots trace the photographed objects in depth.

effects.title: Topographic Scan
effects.desc: Contour lines sweep through sculpted rocky terrain.

effects.title: Return Signal
effects.desc: A violet scan travels from a distant cave opening towards you.

effects.title: Auto Tour
effects.desc: Turns the selected image into a 360 panorama that drifts on its own and stops where you grab it. The layer needs an equirectangular photograph.

effects.title: Drag to Look
effects.desc: A 360 panorama that only moves while the visitor drags it. The layer needs an equirectangular photograph.

effects.title: Slow Drift
effects.desc: The same 360 view, turning slowly enough to read as a still until you look twice.

effects.title: Zoom In Close
effects.desc: A 360 panorama the visitor can also zoom into with the wheel, from wide to more than twice in.

effects.title: Wide Angle
effects.desc: A wider lens on the same sphere: more of the scene at once, with the curve a fisheye gives it.

effects.title: Level Horizon
effects.desc: Turns left and right but never tips up or down, on the desktop and on a phone. For interiors and architecture.

effects.title: Reverse Tour
effects.desc: The tour the other way round, a little quicker, still yours to grab.

effects.title: Scroll Through
effects.desc: The sequence runs as the page scrolls past it. Starts on a sample clip; your own video goes in through the Scroll Video panel.

effects.title: Pinned Scroll
effects.desc: The page holds still while the sequence plays, then lets go and carries on. Starts on a sample clip.

effects.title: Slow Scrub
effects.desc: The same scroll with heavier easing, so the frames trail the gesture instead of snapping to it. Starts on a sample clip.

effects.title: Turntable
effects.desc: Drag left and right to turn the sequence, and it settles back to the middle. For a product on a turntable. Starts on a sample clip.

effects.title: Vertical Scan
effects.desc: Drag up and down to run the sequence, for a scene the reader looks through rather than around. Starts on a sample clip.

effects.title: Magnetic Dust
effects.desc: Approach the portrait. New dust flies toward your hand; older dust keeps its own course.

effects.title: Solar Wind
effects.desc: Waves of dust lift into a fixed wind. The original portrait stays visible throughout.

effects.title: Dust Colony
effects.desc: Hover to release a living colony. Leaders trace organic paths and the rest follow.

effects.title: From Another Direction
effects.desc: Dust arrives, becomes a portrait, holds, disappears completely and returns from a new direction.

effects.title: Violet Disintegration
effects.desc: A luminous portrait dissolves into a violet stream of sparks. Hover to disturb its depth.

effects.title: Ember Drift
effects.desc: Golden light grains lift from the silhouette and drift upwards in a glowing wake.

effects.title: Cyan Aurora
effects.desc: A cool cyan point sculpture streams through a field of soft foreground sparks.

effects.title: Stardust Type
effects.desc: A word built from stardust releases luminous trails from its letterforms.

effects.title: Magnetic Dust / Type
effects.desc: Approach the word. New dust flies toward your hand; older dust keeps its own course.

effects.title: Afterglow
effects.desc: The stream gently settles. Hover or move again to wake it.

effects.title: Solar Wind / Type
effects.desc: Waves of dust lift into a fixed wind. The original word stays visible throughout.

effects.title: Touch of Light
effects.desc: A quiet light sculpture releases a golden stream only while hovered.

effects.title: Dust Colony / Type
effects.desc: Hover to release a living colony. Leaders trace organic paths and the rest follow.

effects.title: From the Dust
effects.desc: Hover to gather a drifting cloud into a portrait. Leave to dissolve it.

effects.title: From Another Direction / Type
effects.desc: Dust arrives, becomes a word, holds, disappears completely and returns from a new direction.

effects.title: Follow the Current
effects.desc: Steer the light with the direction of your hand. The figure keeps its place.

effects.title: Letter Vortex
effects.desc: Stir the letters with a local whirlpool, then let them settle.

effects.title: Photo Vortex
effects.desc: Turn a photograph into a sweeping vortex of textured fragments.

effects.title: Words from Dust
effects.desc: A cloud becomes readable type on hover. Drag through it, then let it go.

effects.title: Mosaic Wave
effects.desc: Large image tiles lift in an expanding wave, then settle back into place.

effects.title: Crystal Lens
effects.desc: A broad magnifying lens stretches the picture into a faceted surface.

effects.title: Wind in the Letters
effects.desc: Move through the word. A soft wave and a gentle lean travel through the letters.

effects.title: Ink Halftone
effects.desc: A monochrome print made of visible dots disperses beneath your hand.

effects.title: Weightless Type
effects.desc: Tilt the letters with your hand while soft gusts carry their dust away.

effects.title: Photo Sandstorm
effects.desc: Thousands of coloured grains sweep with your gesture, forming the photo again at rest.

effects.title: Magnetic Mosaic
effects.desc: A loose mosaic pulls towards the pointer and releases back to its grid.

effects.title: Pixel Downpour
effects.desc: A shower of image fragments falls from the touched area and rises back into the photograph.

effects.title: Photo Shatter
effects.desc: Large textured fragments burst outwards and reassemble along their flight paths.

effects.title: Elastic Pull
effects.desc: The picture follows your hand like an elastic sheet, overshoots a little and settles back.

effects.title: Write, Right Hand
effects.desc: A right hand writes the headline onto the board from the left, then moves on to the next layer.

effects.title: Write, Left Hand
effects.desc: The same headline, written by a left hand.

effects.title: Draw It In
effects.desc: A pen draws the headline rather than writing it, with more angle in the wrist. Works on logos and illustrations too.

effects.title: Sketch Top Down
effects.desc: Drawn from the top edge downwards instead of across, for tall layers and lists.

effects.title: Move Into Place
effects.desc: The hand carries the finished headline in and sets it down instead of writing it.

effects.title: Steady Hand
effects.desc: Few long strokes and almost no wrist: a clean, deliberate hand writing the headline.

effects.title: Loose Hand
effects.desc: Many quick strokes and a lot of wrist: a hurried, sketchy hand writing the headline.
